text: Participate in mediation and dispute resolution.
Direct safety operations in emergency situations.
Lay out reference points for installation of structural and functional components, using measuring instruments.
Evaluate instructor performance and the effectiveness of training programs, providing recommendations for improvement.
Perform construction laborer duties at green building sites, such as renewable energy plants or wind turbine installations.
Secure persons at scene, keeping witnesses from conversing or leaving the scene before investigators arrive.
Lay out designs on metal stock, and cut along markings to fabricate pieces used to cast metal molds.
Coordinate work with other emergency medical team members or police or fire department personnel.
Recommend changes to company procedures in response to changes in regulations or standards.
Provide technical support to users or clients regarding the maintenance, development, or operation of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) databases, equipment, or applications.
Modify and revise designs to correct operating deficiencies or to reduce production problems.
Direct and supervise employees engaged in sales, inventory-taking, reconciling cash receipts, or performing specific services.
Notify other workers of defects, and direct them to adjust extruding and forming machines.
Provide information to the public by leading workshops and training programs and by developing educational materials.
Collaborate with community agencies to establish facilities and programs for persons with disabilities.
Compile and maintain non-monetary reports and records.
Study time, motion, methods, or speed involved in maintenance, production, or other operations to establish standard production rate or improve efficiency.
Perform general administrative tasks, such as taking attendance, editing internal paperwork, and making phone calls.
Maintain files, such as hazardous waste databases, chemical usage data, personnel exposure information, or diagrams showing equipment locations.
Inspect supplies, equipment, or work areas to ensure conformance to established standards.
Support efforts to reduce substance abuse or other illegal activities in the workplace.
Invent names for products and write the slogans that appear on packaging, brochures and other promotional material.
Produce environmental assessment reports, tabulating data and preparing charts, graphs, or sketches.
Maintain knowledge of tax code changes, and of accounting procedures and theory to properly evaluate financial information.
Determine photovoltaic (PV) system designs or configurations based on factors such as customer needs, expectations, and site conditions.
Conduct field investigations, surveys, impact studies, or other research to compile and analyze data on economic, social, regulatory, or physical factors affecting land use.
Verify that property matches legal descriptions or certifications.
Develop or apply data mining and machine learning algorithms.
Maintain records of time required to perform each job.
Design graphics for studio productions.
Communicate with coworkers by signals to direct log movement.
Provide technical support to designers, marketing and sales departments, suppliers, engineers and other team members throughout the product development and implementation process.
Complete forms describing tasks completed.
Operate and maintain mobile dispatch vehicles and equipment.
Monitor or operate boilers, turbines, wells, or auxiliary power plant equipment.
Operate or tend automatic stacking, loading, packaging, or cutting machines.
Inspect sites to assess environmental damage or monitor cleanup progress.
Monitor developments in the fields of industrial technology, business, finance, and economic theory.
Prepare or present reports concerning activities, expenses, budgets, government statutes or rulings, or other items affecting businesses or program services.
Analyze details of sales territories to assess their growth potential and to set quotas.
Monitor the conduct of students to maintain discipline and safety.
Coordinate network operations, maintenance, repairs, or upgrades.
Meet with sponsors and organizing committees to plan scope and format of events, to establish and monitor budgets, or to review administrative procedures and event progress.
Arrange for installation and testing of products or machinery.
Assemble, clean, or maintain equipment or materials for patient use.
Conduct research to evaluate potential solutions related to changes in equipment design, procedures, manpower, personnel, or training.
Apply insurance rating systems.
Test materials and solutions, using testing equipment.
